# Words that appear in the field names of the generated manifest (params, bodies and responses) and are reviewed as
# safe to log: none of them names a credential, a link that signs in, a financial or government identifier, contact
# or address details, or personal data of a person. test/logging.test.ts requires every field name that is not masked
# (src/core/constants.ts) to be made only of these words, or to be listed by name there. A new endpoint with a new word
# fails that test until the word is added here (it is safe) or to SENSITIVE_LOG_KEYS / SENSITIVE_LOG_WORDS (it is not).
# Left out on purpose, because they name a credential or identifier in some fields: account, code, number, key, keys,
# hash. A name that carries one of them is reviewed one by one, in REVIEWED_SAFE.
